description: Known journey failures recorded by Phase 01 (Sept-23 Kaizen). The runner reports a failing test as BASELINE-FAIL only when its test name matches an entry AND its failure message matches the entry's messagePattern, so a different, new failure in the same journey is still FAIL. Tests never encode these as skipped or expected-to-fail. When an owning phase fixes the defect, the runner reports 'PASS (baseline cleared)' and the entry must be removed in that phase.

entries.owner: Phase 04 (stall, K109 via Phase 06/24); Phase 12 (p95 budget)
entries.reason: Turns take about 150-250 ms. Phase CO slice 3 fixed the main starvation of the app's thread pool (K94: the 15 s worker request_timeout once automatic OCR starts). In co-reader-1 to -3 one 10 s stall without an engine restart remained (1 of 6 rows; probable cause K109), and the p95 went over the 250 ms budget in 2 of 6 rows (252 and 422 ms).
